title: 第八章 夜袭
slug: 盛唐风华全本免费-盛唐风华最新章节列表
content_zh:
这已经不是虚无缥缈的感觉了，真切的轻微响动之声，就从不远处的林中传来！
虽然轻微之极，但是徐乐还是可以清楚的分辨出脚步落下时候，踩断枯枝之声。还能分辨出从树林中向上摸来之人，是怎样走两步停一下，仔细观察周遭局势。
年少时候，爷爷带自己入深山，将一个十岁出头的孩子丢在那里，然后不定什么时候，不定什么方位，突然摸出来，只要防备不及，就是一顿臭揍。
防备及时了，还是一顿臭揍。自家那时才十岁出头，还打得过老而弥坚的爷爷不成？
就是在这样一个个寂静的夜里，在山林里的狼嚎虎啸声中，自己这个十岁出头的孩子，拖着眼泪鼻涕仔细分辨着周遭每一点响动，熬过一个又一个漫漫长夜。
六识敏锐，对危险的直觉。每一点长进，都是自家少年生涯满满的血泪痛史啊……
徐乐静悄悄的翻身而起，而这个时候，坐在石上的韩约，似乎也听见了响动，第一时间回头过来，压低声音对徐乐道：“乐郎君，你别上前！”
徐乐站定脚步，韩约应付不了，自己再出手不迟。自己转过头去，将庄客们一一拍醒。
说实在的，对于自家爷爷也花了相当大精神调教出来的韩约，徐乐也有绝对的信心。
山间遇伏，不是盗贼，就是马匪。这动静也不是有多少人朝这里悄悄摸来的样子，韩约一人，足以拾掇得下！
韩约一把拾起脚下的长方形包袱，慢慢掀开了包袱皮，露出一面生铁打造的盾牌。
盾牌长约三尺，宽约一尺有半。沉甸甸的足有十三四斤的分量。盾牌正面，蚀刻出一个神荼的形象，手持铁鞭，煞气腾腾。金属打造的盾牌，在星光下反射着幽幽的光芒。
韩约提着盾牌，走到宋宝他们身边，一脚将宋宝踢醒，宋宝一惊睁眼，张口就要骂人。看着韩约绷紧的面孔，宋宝毕竟当了这么多年侠少，厮斗经验颇有一些，顿时就收住了声。
韩约朝山下树林指指，自己提着铁牌蹑着步子，迎上前去。
宋宝忙不迭的将兄弟们全都推醒，这些侠少都睡得懵懵懂懂，有人张口要说话，却被宋宝按住了嘴巴。
星光下宋宝面容扭曲，压着嗓门：“真有敌人！”
在另一边，几名庄客也都爬了起来，徐乐一个个都嘱咐了不得高声，这些庄客们抖索着去取出随身兵刃。
不管是庄客还是侠少，边地男儿的随身兵刃都差不多，都是一张弓，再是一两撒袋的羽箭。随身再是一把直刀。只是民间所用军器，赶不上军中的精利。所用角弓，弓力超过一石的都少，直刀也最多不过三炼的熟铁，真要厮杀一场都得报废大半。
侠少和庄客们这个时候也顾不得互相之间瞧不上了，肩并肩站在了一处，纵然都放轻了动作，但仍不时传出各种碰撞的轻响之声，在这安静的深山夜中，这点响动似乎就大得如同响雷一般。
宋宝手中兵刃，却是一支单钺戟，能使动这等重心不平衡的长兵刃，不是真有两分本事，就是装逼。

宋宝算是前者，他的一个本家叔叔，当年也是北周军中一个小武官，贺拔岳老柱国的部下。伤了筋骨返回乡里，自家子弟没教养出来，早逝之后家门沦落。当初父母早逝托庇门下的宋宝却学出了他叔叔的本事，因为受不得白眼愤而流落江湖。
一杆单钺戟，马术又精熟。参加过马邑郡内好几场动用了马匹军器的厮斗，快马长戟，就闯出了铁飞燕这么个名号！
山中陡然遇袭，宋宝倒没什么好惧怕的，他是个狠厉的性子，不把别人性命当回事，也不把自己性命当回事。可环顾一下左右，自家侠少在夜色当中都紧张得直咽唾沫，那几名庄客从撒袋中取出羽箭，插在地上都因为手抖插得歪歪斜斜。
再看被庄客们护在身后的徐乐，还空着两只手，脸上居然还带着潇洒的笑意。虽然乐郎君一笑就是丰神如玉，可马上可能就要有一场厮杀！
宋宝摇头，握紧铁戟，目光只是追着韩约一步步向前的身影，现下能指望上的，只有小门神韩约了。
入娘的，但愿夜中而来的，不是什么硬手！

content_en:
This was no longer an illusory feeling, a real slight sound came from the forest not far away!
Although it was extremely slight, Xu Le could still clearly distinguish the sound of breaking dead branches when his footsteps fell. You can also tell how the person coming up from the woods takes two steps to stop and carefully observe the situation around him.
When he was young, his grandfather took him into the mountains and left a ten-year-old child there. Then he would suddenly pull it out at any time or in any direction. If he was not prepared, he would be beaten up.
Even if he was prepared in time, he still received a nasty beating. I was only in my early ten years at that time, could I beat my grandfather who was old and strong?
It was in such silent nights, amidst the howls of wolves and tigers in the mountains and forests, that I, a child in his early ten years, carefully discerned every sound around him with tears and snot in his eyes, and spent one long night after another.
The six senses are keen and intuitive to danger. Every bit of progress is a history of blood, tears and pain in my youth life...
Xu Le quietly stood up, and at this time, Han Yue, who was sitting on the stone, seemed to have heard the noise. He turned around immediately and lowered his voice and said to Xu Le: "Le Langjun, don't come forward!"
Xu Le stood still. Han Yue couldn't handle it, so he would take action again. He turned around and slapped the dealers awake one by one.
To be honest, Xu Le also has absolute confidence in Han Yue, whom his grandfather spent a lot of effort training.
If you encounter an ambush in the mountains, they are either thieves or horse bandits. This movement didn't look like there were many people sneaking here. Han Yue could handle it with just one person!
Han Yue picked up the rectangular baggage at his feet and slowly opened the baggage, revealing a shield made of pig iron.
The shield is about three feet long and one and a half feet wide. It's heavy enough to weigh thirteen or fourteen kilograms. On the front of the shield, an image of Shen Tu is etched, holding an iron whip and full of evil aura. The shield made of metal reflected a faint light under the starlight.
Han Yue carried the shield, walked up to Song Bao and the others, and kicked Song Bao awake. Song Bao opened his eyes in shock and opened his mouth to curse. Looking at Han Yue's tense face, Song Bao, after all, had been a young knight for so many years and had quite a bit of fighting experience, so he immediately stopped talking.
Han Yue pointed towards the woods at the foot of the mountain, and walked forward with a tiptoe, holding the iron sign.
Song Bao hurriedly pushed all the brothers awake. These young heroes were all sleeping in a daze. Some of them opened their mouths to speak, but Song Bao held their mouths down.
Under the starlight, Song Bao's face was distorted and he lowered his voice: "There are really enemies!"
On the other side, several bankers also got up. Xu Le asked each one not to speak loudly. These bankers shook their heads and took out their weapons.
Regardless of whether they are bankers or young knights, the weapons carried by border men are all the same. They all have a bow and one or two arrows thrown into the bag. Carry a straight knife with you. It's just that the weapons used by the people cannot keep up with the sophistication of the military. The horn bows used were rarely more powerful than one stone, and the straight swords were no more than three-forged wrought iron. Most of them would have to be scrapped if they really wanted to fight.
At this time, the young man and the banker didn't care about looking down on each other. They stood side by side. Even though they moved lightly, there were still soft sounds of various collisions from time to time. In this quiet night in the mountains, this noise seemed as loud as thunder.
The weapon in Song Bao's hand is a single halberd. To be able to use such a long weapon with an unbalanced center of gravity is either a real skill or a pretense.
Song Bao is considered to be the former. One of his uncles was also a junior military attache in the Northern Zhou Army and a subordinate of He Ba Yue Laozhu. He returned to his hometown with broken muscles and bones, but his children were uneducated and his family fell into ruin after his early death. Song Bao, whose parents died young and took care of him, learned from his uncle's skills and ended up living in the world because he couldn't bear the anger of his eyes.
He has a single halberd and is skilled in horsemanship.Participated in several fights in Mayi County using horses and weapons, fast horses and long halberds, and gained the name Tie Feiyan!
There was a sudden attack in the mountains. Song Bao had nothing to fear. He had a ruthless temper and did not take other people's lives seriously, nor did he take his own life seriously. But looking around, I saw that my young knight was so nervous that he was swallowing his saliva in the dark of night. The bankers took out their arrows from their bags and inserted them crookedly on the ground because their hands were shaking.
Looking at Xu Le, who was protected by the dealers, he still had two hands free, and he actually had a chic smile on his face. Although Mr. Lelang is as handsome as a jade when he smiles, there may be a fight soon!
Song Bao shook his head and held the iron halberd tightly, his eyes just chasing Han Yue's figure moving forward step by step. The only one he could count on now was the little doorkeeper Han Yue.
Damn it, I hope what comes in the night is not a tough one!
